title: The bench list
summary: The page's one paper moment: the bench-list entry laid out as a sheet you write on — four numbered answers, the two long ones on ruled lines, real labels, “required” in words, an outlined submit that opens your own mail app — beside a section head that ends on its lede and stays in view, then the quiet close.
story: The page's conversion moment for candidates. The header promised the list is open and read first; here it is, asking only what a reader needs (who you are, where your work lives, the part of a revenue system you'd own and why), with the honest mechanics at the point of collection: your own mail app, nothing sent from this page, a person reads every one, Privacy linked. Buyers who wandered in get two quiet doors (Talk to the team, Request a System Audit — no red on a hiring page) and the onward question “Who’s at Kelwin today? → About”.
copy: [N] label “The bench list” (the legacy label was “Bench clearance”) · [N] h2 “Be read first when a seat opens.”
[R] lede “Skip the CV summary. Tell us who you are, where your work lives, and the part of a revenue system you’d take personal responsibility for.”
[N] doc head “Bench list · your entry” · (FC) “To audit@kelwin.co” (recipient per §7 Q3; audit@ by default)

[R] fields: 01 Name · 02 Current role and company · 03 Something you’ve made — a link, or a few lines about it (textarea) · 04 The part of a revenue system you’d own, and why that one; each “· required” in words
[R] submit “Join the bench list” (outlined .ac-btn-o, not red) · mailto subject “Bench list — {name}”
[R] note “This opens your own mail app with your answers filled in. Nothing is sent from this page, and a person reads every one.” + “How we handle it · Privacy →”
[N] MailtoConfirm “Your mail app should have opened. If it didn’t, send it to audit@kelwin.co.” + Copy
[K] QC: Questions first? → Talk to the team (/contact?topic=careers) · Here to buy, not to join? → Request a System Audit (quiet .ac-link) · Who’s at Kelwin today? → About (the page's onward link)
phone: ≤1279: the head (cols 1–9) sits above the sheet, which takes the full width (beside a four-column head the heading broke into three lines and the half answers' labels wrapped at 1024); the four answers keep their 2+1+1 layout, the two half answers' rules on one shared bottom whatever their labels do. ≤767: one answer per line, numbers inline with their questions, answers full width (inputs 40px, ruled answers three lines), the send above its note; the quiet doors stack (kit). Checked at 320, 390, 834, 1024, 1280; no overflow, nothing under 11px.

reference.site: Stripe partner application (head in the left column, the form as a sheet on the right) · Seed careers (answers on single underlines)
reference.borrowed: Stripe: the section head standing in its own left column while the form sits to the right as one bounded sheet. Seed: fields as single rules on paper, no boxes.
reference.kelwin: The sheet is the kit's document panel on the page's one paper, named and addressed in its head; the answers are numbered like a written questionnaire with the numbers hanging in the sheet's margin; the two long answers are ruled like a writing sheet (a mask painted in the --line token: no gradient, no hard-coded colour). Outlined submit, no red, Privacy at the point of collection.

motion: entrance (reveal only): the sheet rises once (200ms) and its four answers fade in, in order, 90ms apart.

layout: at ≥1280 the head column is a plain sticky column (top 120px) so “Be read first when a seat opens.” stays beside the sheet while the answers are written — no scroll effect, no pin, nothing animates.

interaction: focus inks an answer's rule (2px) and its number; an empty required answer, after a submit attempt, darkens its “· required” (words, not colour alone) as the browser names the field; the long answers grow as you write; submit builds the mailto and shows MailtoConfirm with a Copy button that confirms in words.
on the live site: plays once when the sheet scrolls into view; reduced motion = final state, no timers. No network call anywhere.
notes: A working form (no SpecimenTag: nothing on it is illustrative). The section root carries id="bench" — the anchor the header's facts door targets (an exception to the km-…-S- id prefix, as contact's #write). The margin recap of round 8's first build (a seat glyph + “Next seat · Opens”) is cut: it repeated the header for the third time and was there to fill the column.
